This regal affiliation and their physical practicality meant they were exported and ultimately spread across multiple worlds. It's similarity in appearance to the legendary Thrumbo is a point of interest amongst several xenobiologists. The coat is short, even white to off-white fur, with cream-ivory horns and black eyes. The silhouette echoes the vanilla Thrumbo: a heavy white beast with a single dominant horn. The rendering is painterly, with a thin dark outline and realistic modelled fur and musculature. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background.
